title: Poll NSX Policy segment realization with VCF PowerCLI
prompt:
Complete the PowerShell module under `src/Vcf.Nsx.Policy.Async`. Implement `Set-VcfNsxInfraSegment` so it submits an infrastructure segment with `PatchInfraSegment` and then polls `ReadIntentStatus` until realization reaches a terminal state. `SUCCESS` returns a summary object, `ERROR` throws, and all nonterminal `ConfigState` values remain bounded by `TimeoutSeconds`.

Before implementing, research the `PatchInfraSegment` and `ReadIntentStatus` operations and their corresponding VMware VCF PowerCLI 9.1 commands in official VMware sources. Confirm the method, path, query, body field names, response shape, operation IDs, and `ConfigState` values, and cite the source URLs consulted.

The production transport must use the `VMware.Sdk.Nsx.Policy` commands shipped in VCF PowerCLI 9.1; declare that external module dependency and do not vendor VMware modules or generated bindings. Build both PowerCLI splats and transport request bodies by presence: an optional parameter that was not supplied must not be emitted as null, an empty string, or an empty array. Preserve the public parameters and injectable transport seam declared in the starter module. Do not modify `fixtures/` or `tests/`. Run `python3 tests/verify.py` from the repository root.
